title: Feature Flag Is On Even When Set to "false"
description:
`is_feature_enabled(flag_value)` reads a feature flag that comes in as a **string** (like from an environment variable) and should return `True` only when the string is `"true"` (case-insensitive), `False` otherwise. Right now it treats the string `"false"` as enabled too. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`is_feature_enabled(flag_value: str) -> bool`

**Example**
`is_feature_enabled("true")` -> `True`, `is_feature_enabled("false")` -> `False`, `is_feature_enabled("")` -> `False`.
